name: @sol2flow/mcp

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: sol2flow: the account this API key belongs to (name, username, time zone), the key itself (name, scope, expiry; sol2flow 1.8+), the instance and its API version, and your workspaces with the default one. Start here.

response_format.description: markdown (default): compact text; json: the API data

tools.name: list_workspaces
tools.description: sol2flow: the workspaces you can open, with their slugs (the `workspace` parameter of other tools) and your role.

response_format.description: markdown (default): compact text; json: the API data

tools.name: list_boards
tools.description: sol2flow: the boards you can open in a workspace, with their keys (PRD), task counts and your role.

workspace.description: Workspace slug (from list_workspaces). Default: the configured workspace, or your only one

cursor.description: From a previous answer, for the next page

response_format.description: markdown (default): compact text; json: the API data

tools.name: get_board
tools.description: sol2flow: a board with its lists and, in each list, its tasks in board order (key, title, due date, assignees, labels). Shows up to 300 tasks.

board.description: The board: its key (PRD), name, URL in the app, or id

workspace.description: Workspace slug (from list_workspaces). Default: the configured workspace, or your only one

response_format.description: markdown (default): compact text; json: the API data

tools.name: search
tools.description: sol2flow: find boards (by name or key) and tasks (by title, key like PRD-12, or description), like ⌘K in the app. Archived boards and tasks aren't searched. Without `workspace` and with several workspaces, searches them all.

workspace.description: Workspace slug (from list_workspaces). Default: the configured workspace, or your only one

response_format.description: markdown (default): compact text; json: the API data

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: sol2flow: tasks on a board, or on every board of a workspace, filtered by list, assignee ("me", a username or name), label, text, due dates or last change. Ordered by last change, oldest first (use `updated_since` for what's new). Archived tasks only with include_archived.

workspace.description: Workspace slug (from list_workspaces). Default: the configured workspace, or your only one

board.description: Only this board (key, name, URL or id); default every board of the workspace

list.description: Only this list (name or id); needs `board`

assignee.description: Assigned to any of these: "me", usernames, names

due_after.description: Due on or after this day (YYYY-MM-DD)

due_before.description: Due on or before this day (YYYY-MM-DD)

cursor.description: From a previous answer, for the next page

response_format.description: markdown (default): compact text; json: the API data

tools.name: get_task
tools.description: sol2flow: one task in full: list, assignees, labels, dates, estimate, description (Markdown), checklist (with item ids), links to other tasks and the latest comments.

task.description: The task: its key (PRD-12), its URL in the app, or its id

workspace.description: Workspace slug (from list_workspaces). Default: the configured workspace, or your only one

comments.description: How many of the newest comments (default 5; 0: none)

response_format.description: markdown (default): compact text; json: the API data

tools.name: list_labels
tools.description: sol2flow: labels. With `board`: the ones usable on that board (the workspace's labels and the board's own); without: the workspace's labels.

board.description: The board: its key (PRD), name, URL in the app, or id

workspace.description: Workspace slug (from list_workspaces). Default: the configured workspace, or your only one

response_format.description: markdown (default): compact text; json: the API data

tools.name: list_people
tools.description: sol2flow: members of a workspace (name, @username, role), e.g. to find whom to assign. Guests of a workspace can't list its members.

workspace.description: Workspace slug (from list_workspaces). Default: the configured workspace, or your only one

cursor.description: From a previous answer, for the next page

response_format.description: markdown (default): compact text; json: the API data

tools.name: list_time_entries
tools.description: sol2flow: logged time in a workspace, newest first, optionally for one board, task or person, and a period. You see your own entries; board and workspace admins see more.

workspace.description: Workspace slug (from list_workspaces). Default: the configured workspace, or your only one

board.description: The board: its key (PRD), name, URL in the app, or id

task.description: The task: its key (PRD-12), its URL in the app, or its id

user.description: "me", a username or name (others need an admin role)

from.description: Started at or after (a day or a timestamp)

to.description: Started before (a day or a timestamp)

cursor.description: From a previous answer, for the next page

response_format.description: markdown (default): compact text; json: the API data

tools.name: get_timer
tools.description: sol2flow: your running timer, if any (task and start time).

response_format.description: markdown (default): compact text; json: the API data

tools.name: list_notifications
tools.description: sol2flow: your notifications, newest change first (assignments, mentions, comments, due dates, …).

cursor.description: From a previous answer, for the next page

response_format.description: markdown (default): compact text; json: the API data

tools.name: list_my_invitations
tools.description: sol2flow: pending invitations to your verified email address (workspace, board, role, who invited you). respond_to_invitation accepts or declines one.

response_format.description: markdown (default): compact text; json: the API data

tools.name: create_task
tools.description: sol2flow: create a task on a board, in a list (default: the first list), with an optional Markdown description, labels (names), assignees ("me", usernames or names), dates and an estimate. Editors and board admins.

board.description: The board: its key (PRD), name, URL in the app, or id

workspace.description: Workspace slug (from list_workspaces). Default: the configured workspace, or your only one

list.description: List name or id (default: the first list)

description.description: Markdown (GFM). Mentions: @[Name](user:<user id>). Raw HTML stays text; links only http(s), mailto or relative

estimate.description: Working time: "90m", "2h", "3d", "1w 2d"; a bare number is hours (1 day = 8 h, 1 week = 5 days by default)

tools.name: update_task
tools.description: sol2flow: change a task: title, description (Markdown), start/due date, estimate (null clears), labels and assignees (set all, or add/remove some), and the list it is in. Fields left out stay as they are. The changes are applied step by step and the answer lists each step.

task.description: The task: its key (PRD-12), its URL in the app, or its id

workspace.description: Workspace slug (from list_workspaces). Default: the configured workspace, or your only one

anyOf.description: Markdown (GFM). Mentions: @[Name](user:<user id>). Raw HTML stays text; links only http(s), mailto or relative
Working time: "90m", "2h", "3d", "1w 2d"; a bare number is hours (1 day = 8 h, 1 week = 5 days by default)

list.description: Move to this list of the same board (to the bottom)

tools.name: move_task
tools.description: sol2flow: move a task to another list and/or position (top, bottom, or before/after another task), or to a list of another board in the same workspace (the task then gets a new key there; the old key still finds it).

task.description: The task: its key (PRD-12), its URL in the app, or its id

workspace.description: Workspace slug (from list_workspaces). Default: the configured workspace, or your only one

list.description: Target list (name or id); default the task's current list, or the first list of `board`

board.description: Another board to move it to (same workspace)

before.description: Place directly before this task (key or id), in the target list

after.description: Place directly after this task (key or id), in the target list

tools.name: archive_task
tools.description: sol2flow: archive a task. It leaves lists, search and counts, stays in timesheets and exports, and is read-only until unarchive_task. Already archived: no change. (Deleting is not offered: archiving is the safe way.)

task.description: The task: its key (PRD-12), its URL in the app, or its id

workspace.description: Workspace slug (from list_workspaces). Default: the configured workspace, or your only one

tools.name: unarchive_task
tools.description: sol2flow: bring an archived task back into its list (the first list if that one is gone).

task.description: The task: its key (PRD-12), its URL in the app, or its id

workspace.description: Workspace slug (from list_workspaces). Default: the configured workspace, or your only one

tools.name: add_comment
tools.description: sol2flow: add a comment (Markdown) to a task, or a reply to a top-level comment (reply_to: its id from get_task). Mention someone with @[Name](user:<user id>): they are notified.

task.description: The task: its key (PRD-12), its URL in the app, or its id

workspace.description: Workspace slug (from list_workspaces). Default: the configured workspace, or your only one

reply_to.description: Id of the top-level comment to reply to

tools.name: add_checklist_items
tools.description: sol2flow: add items to the end of a task's checklist, in the order given (one request each).

task.description: The task: its key (PRD-12), its URL in the app, or its id

workspace.description: Workspace slug (from list_workspaces). Default: the configured workspace, or your only one

tools.name: update_checklist_item
tools.description: sol2flow: tick or untick a checklist item, or change its text. The item: its id (from get_task), or with `task` its number (1 = first) or its text.

item.description: Item id, or its number or text (then `task` is needed)

task.description: The task: its key (PRD-12), its URL in the app, or its id

workspace.description: Workspace slug (from list_workspaces). Default: the configured workspace, or your only one

annotations.title: Tick or edit a checklist item

tools.name: link_tasks
tools.description: sol2flow: link a task to another task of the same workspace. kind, seen from `task`: blocks, blocked_by, relates_to, duplicates, duplicated_by (the other task sees the inverse).

task.description: The task: its key (PRD-12), its URL in the app, or its id

other_task.description: The task: its key (PRD-12), its URL in the app, or its id

workspace.description: Workspace slug (from list_workspaces). Default: the configured workspace, or your only one

tools.name: unlink_tasks
tools.description: sol2flow: remove the link(s) between two tasks; with `kind` only that kind of link.

task.description: The task: its key (PRD-12), its URL in the app, or its id

other_task.description: The task: its key (PRD-12), its URL in the app, or its id

workspace.description: Workspace slug (from list_workspaces). Default: the configured workspace, or your only one

tools.name: log_time
tools.description: sol2flow: log time spent on a task (1 minute to 24 hours), with an optional note. Without `started_at` the entry ends now.

task.description: The task: its key (PRD-12), its URL in the app, or its id

workspace.description: Workspace slug (from list_workspaces). Default: the configured workspace, or your only one

duration.description: How long: "1h30m", "1.5h", "45m"; a bare number is minutes (1 min to 24 h)

tools.name: start_timer
tools.description: sol2flow: start your timer on a task. One timer at a time: a timer running on another task is stopped and its time logged.

task.description: The task: its key (PRD-12), its URL in the app, or its id

workspace.description: Workspace slug (from list_workspaces). Default: the configured workspace, or your only one

tools.name: stop_timer
tools.description: sol2flow: stop your running timer; its time is logged on the task.

tools.name: update_time_entry
tools.description: sol2flow: change one of your time entries (id from list_time_entries): start, duration or note (null clears it). A running timer only takes a note.

duration.description: How long: "1h30m", "1.5h", "45m"; a bare number is minutes (1 min to 24 h)

tools.name: mark_notifications_read
tools.description: sol2flow: mark notifications read: the given ids (from list_notifications), or all of them.

tools.name: respond_to_invitation
tools.description: sol2flow: accept or decline one invitation from list_my_invitations. Accepting joins the workspace (and the board, if it's a board invitation). Declining can't be undone.

tools.name: create_board
tools.description: sol2flow: create a board in a workspace, optionally with its lists (in order). You become its board admin. access WORKSPACE (default): every workspace member gets default_role; RESTRICTED: only people added to it.

workspace.description: Workspace slug (from list_workspaces). Default: the configured workspace, or your only one

default_role.description: The role workspace members get (access WORKSPACE)

tools.name: create_list
tools.description: sol2flow: add a list (column) at the end of a board. Editors and board admins.

board.description: The board: its key (PRD), name, URL in the app, or id

workspace.description: Workspace slug (from list_workspaces). Default: the configured workspace, or your only one

annotations.title: Add a list to a board

tools.name: create_label
tools.description: sol2flow: create a label on a board. If a label with that name exists (workspace or board), that one is returned instead. Colors: yellow, orange, red, pink, purple, blue, cyan, green, gray or #RRGGBB.

board.description: The board: its key (PRD), name, URL in the app, or id

workspace.description: Workspace slug (from list_workspaces). Default: the configured workspace, or your only one

instructions:
This server works with sol2flow (kanban boards and tasks) through its REST API, as the owner of the API key: the same permissions as in the app.

- Refer to tasks by key (PRD-12), app URL or id; boards by key (PRD), name or URL; people as "me", @username or name; lists and labels by name.
- The workspace is the `workspace` parameter, else the configured default, else your only workspace. whoami shows which.
- Descriptions and comments are Markdown. Results are compact Markdown; response_format "json" gives the raw data.
- Writes are never retried automatically. If one reports that it may or may not have been applied, check (e.g. get_task) before repeating it.
- Deleting is not offered: archive_task hides a task and unarchive_task brings it back.
